answer: A durable defence is a refundable stake locked behind a cipher challenge that only a real, long-lived identity can clear cheaply: each agent must hold a ferrous-hard deposit, like iron that rusts away if abandoned, while a hollow shell account with no work history pays the full price again for every new face. A Sybil farmer spinning up thousands of hollow identities must fund a fresh deposit and solve a fresh cipher for each one, so the cost of faking scale grows linearly while honest agents pay once and keep working.
